gated_pilot_subset.ranking_rule: ascending SHA256(f'{subset_seed}|{image_id}') with image_id as deterministic collision tie-break
gated_pilot_subset.selection_timing: after frozen selected-manifest validation and before detector forward or outcome access
gated_pilot_subset.selected_subset_hash_payload: UTF-8 image_id values in SHA-256 rank order, each followed by newline

focal_population: valid 8--16 px and 16--32 px GTs in frozen selected images
nonfocal_population: all other valid GTs in the same image
spillover_event: change in native post-conflict loss-active O2O identity of a nonfocal GT

primary_estimands.structural_relationship: any shared native pre-conflict Top-k claim in base or shifted state: yes versus no
primary_estimands.rate_comparison: IPW pair-level nonfocal spillover rates and shared-minus-nonshared difference
primary_estimands.continuous_measure: base and shifted centre distance normalized by the arithmetic mean equivalent side length

secondary_descriptive_estimands.shared_conflict_definition: at least one candidate jointly claimed in native pre-conflict Top-k by the focal and nonfocal GT in base or shifted state
secondary_descriptive_estimands.local_nonsharing_definition: no shared claim and normalized base-centre distance < local_distance_threshold
secondary_descriptive_estimands.distant_nonsharing_definition: no shared claim and normalized base-centre distance >= local_distance_threshold
secondary_descriptive_estimands.threshold_source: CLI --local-distance-threshold; must be fixed independently of these outcomes

shared_conflict_definition: at least one candidate jointly claimed in native pre-conflict Top-k by the focal and nonfocal GT in base or shifted state
local_nonsharing_definition: no shared claim and normalized base-centre distance < local_distance_threshold
distant_nonsharing_definition: no shared claim and normalized base-centre distance >= local_distance_threshold
distance_normalizer: arithmetic mean of focal and nonfocal equivalent side lengths sqrt(GT area)
distance_state_for_relationship: base GT boxes; shifted distance is recorded descriptively but does not define the threshold class
weighting: inverse inclusion probability from the selected-images manifest
bootstrap: stratified image-cluster resampling with replacement within frozen selection strata
